Prerequisite(s): Raiden Thrust feat, BAB +7

Benefit: At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special polearm attack that takes the place of an attack in a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack deals normal damage + 1d6 points of damage, and the opponent must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half of your character level + your Strength or Dexterity modifier) or be forced prone and staggered for 1d4 rounds. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deal normal damage + 2d6 points of damage and force your target to make a Fortitude save (DC 12 + half of your character level + your Strength or Dexterity modifier) or be forced prone and staggered for 2d4 rounds. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to deal normal damage + 3d6 points of damage and force your target to make a Fortitude save (DC 14 + half of your character level + your Strength or Dexterity modifier) or be forced prone and staggered for 3d4 rounds.
